text:
Augustus III bought Correggio's *Adoration of the Shepherds* (*Holy Night*) in 1746. It was part of the Duke of Modena's picture sale to Dresden, and it now hangs in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister. I'm choosing it over *Jupiter and Io*, which was never in the Dresden collection. This revises my earlier answer of *Madonna of Saint George*.

CONFIDENCE: 85
